input.name: activate-resolves-the-annotation-tree
input.covers: An activate trigger resolves current objectNumber and stable baseIndex refs on their own pages; mismatched kinds, pages and absent refs find nothing. Historical NM/revision-index spellings are archived.

input.name: annotation-events-resolve-their-aa-tree
input.covers: Each of the six /AA pointer events resolves its own tree; absence is silently inert; the hover pair is hover-origin and the rest are user-origin.

input.name: a-source-hint-is-provenance-only
input.covers: A first-party source hint becomes the step source, and the origin is still derived from the trigger.

input.name: a-precedes-aa-u
input.covers: /A shadows the /AA U tree: a mouseUp on an annotation with /A is inert; without /A its U tree runs.

input.name: an-incomplete-trigger-tree-is-refused
input.covers: A rootless but incomplete tree still becomes a step, and the step is refused; the trigger folds to refused.

diagnostics.message: refused: the action tree is incomplete

input.name: resolution-never-rejects
input.covers: A failed annotation read and an unknown page both come back refused with trigger-failed; dispatch never rejects.

input.name: submission-order-is-execution-order
input.covers: Two dispatches run in call order even when the first read is slower.

input.name: page-fan-out-order
input.covers: open runs page /O then the /PO set; close runs the /PC set then /C; visible and invisible fan only their sets; rootless trees and tree-less annotations are no steps.

input.name: a-failed-step-never-skips-its-siblings
input.covers: A /PC step that fails is partial; the page /C still runs, and the trigger folds to partial.

input.name: single-tree-lifecycle-annotations
input.covers: An annotation bearing only one lifecycle tree (close, visible or invisible) is still in the lifecycle set.

input.name: an-all-inert-fan-out-is-inert
input.covers: Steps that all come back inert fold to inert.

input.name: deferred-navigation-flushes-per-step
input.covers: A page /O goto fires inside its own step, before the /PO step runs.

input.name: lifecycle-cache-and-invalidation
input.covers: Lifecycle trees are read once per page; confirmed annotations.updated for that page and stream.desynced clear the cache, other events do not; close unsubscribes.
input.reason: Pins when lifecycle trees are read and which trigger families fire, through the engine reads and the dispatch outcomes. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: trigger-gates
input.covers: Disabled families are inert with trigger-disabled and canDispatch false; activate is never gated.

diagnostics.message: page: trigger family disabled by config
annotation: trigger family disabled by config
document: trigger family disabled by config

input.name: gates-default-open
input.covers: A triggers object with no families set leaves every family enabled.
input.reason: Pins when lifecycle trees are read and which trigger families fire, through the engine reads and the dispatch outcomes. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

input.name: auto-fires-on-adapter-install
input.covers: Pre-open reports are buffered and coalesced; an adapter install runs the openDestination goto, then OpenAction, then the page open the latest report asks for; another adapter never replays it.

input.name: auto-fires-ahead-of-the-first-user-dispatch
input.covers: The first user-origin dispatch arms the sequence before taking its own queue slot.

input.name: open-sequence-completed-event
input.covers: onOpenSequenceCompleted fires once with the folded sequence result after the document steps; a throwing listener is reported to the host sink and never stops its siblings.

input.name: auto-a-submit-handler-does-not-arm
input.covers: Installing a submit handler is not the latch release: nothing runs until an adapter arrives.

input.name: headless-falls-back-to-the-first-page
input.covers: headless fires at bring-up; with no stage report the initial page open is the first page.

input.name: headless-with-a-report
input.covers: headless with a buffered report opens the reported page instead of the first.

input.name: headless-with-no-pages
input.covers: headless on a document with no pages releases the barrier and opens nothing.

input.name: off-releases-the-barrier
input.covers: off never runs the sequence but a report emits straight away.

input.name: a-replayed-open-trigger
input.covers: A document-open trigger after the sequence fired reports open-sequence-replayed; before it fired, it runs the sequence.

input.name: open-sequence-read-fails
input.covers: A failed catalog read inside the sequence is a trigger-failed diagnostic; the barrier still releases and a later report emits.

input.name: no-actions-service
input.covers: The current required actions service returns an empty catalog: no lifecycle trees run; a second open is a replay.

diagnostics.message: document open sequence already fired for this document

input.name: coordinator-diffs
input.covers: Unplaced reports are ignored; a placed report emits close(old), invisible, visible, open(new); a report with no change emits nothing; a current page of null closes without opening.

input.name: cascade-budget
input.covers: Consecutive programmatic rounds past the cap are suppressed with a cascade-budget diagnostic (state still tracked); a user-caused report resets the count.

input.name: cascade-budget-resets-on-user-activity
input.covers: A user-origin dispatch resets the cascade count, and so does a user report while the barrier is closed.

input.name: the-five-catalog-trees
input.covers: Each verb-shaped document event resolves its Table-200 tree through dispatch; a missing tree is inert.

input.name: missing-trees-are-inert
input.covers: A catalog without the tree, or with a rootless one, is inert.

input.name: open-runs-before-the-first-document-event
input.covers: Under auto with the latch still armed, a first will-save runs the OpenAction inline first; the sequence then counts as fired.

diagnostics.message: document open sequence already fired for this document

input.name: a-rejected-catalog-read-is-evicted
input.covers: A rejected catalog read degrades to trigger-failed and is evicted, so the next event reads again.

input.name: document-family-disabled
input.covers: triggers.document false: runDocumentVerb skips both trees and still runs the operation; dispatch of a document event is trigger-disabled.

diagnostics.message: document: trigger family disabled by config
document: trigger family disabled by config

input.name: prepare-close
input.covers: prepareClose runs the will-close tree through the dispatch door.

input.name: run-document-verb-serializes
input.covers: Two concurrent save verbs never interleave: the second waits for the first operation and its did-save.

input.name: run-document-verb-failure-laws
input.covers: A failing will-save never cancels the operation; an operation that throws or rejects skips did-save and rethrows.

input.name: run-document-verb-print-holds-the-latch
input.covers: The print verb holds the print latch for its whole body: a Named Print inside will-print is suppressed as reentrant, and the latch is released after.

input.name: print-verb-runs-wp-adapter-dp
input.covers: A Named Print runs will-print, the adapter exactly once, then did-print; a Print nested in will-print is suppressed with reentrant-print.

input.name: an-adapter-throw-skips-did-print
input.covers: An adapter print that throws rejects execute and skips did-print; the latch resets, so a later print works.

input.name: adapter-uninstalled-mid-print
input.covers: An adapter cleared while will-print runs leaves the print no-executor, without did-print.

input.name: an-open-uri-throw-rejects-execute
input.covers: An adapter openUri that throws rejects execute; the counter does not move.
